text:
Predicates:
RankedHighly(x) ::: x is ranked highly by the Women's Tennis Association.
ActivePlayer(x) ::: x is among the most active players in major tennis.
LostTo(x, y) ::: x lost to y.
FemalePlayerAtRG2022(x) ::: x is a female tennis player at Roland Garros 2022.
MalePlayerAtRG2022(x) ::: x is a male tennis player at Roland Garros 2022.
Player(x) ::: x is a player.
Specialize(x, y) ::: x specializes in y.
Premises:
∀x (RankedHighly(x) → ActivePlayer(x)) ::: If a player is ranked highly, then they are among the most active players.
∀x (LostTo(x, IgaŚwiątek)) ::: Everyone who lost to Iga Świątek.
∀x (FemalePlayerAtRG2022(x) → LostTo(x, IgaŚwiątek)) ::: All female players at RG 2022 lost to Iga Świątek.
(∀x (FemalePlayerAtRG2022(x) ∨ MalePlayerAtRG2022(x))) ::: Female or male players at RG 2022.
∀x (MalePlayerAtRG2022(x) → LostTo(x, RafaelNadal)) ::: All male players at RG 2022 lost to Rafael Nadal.
(∀x (CocoGauff(x) → (RankedHighly(x) ∨ LostTo(x, RafaelNadal)))) ::: If Coco Gauff is ranked highly or lost to Rafael Nadal.

Conclusion:
(CocoGauff(CocoGauff) → ¬MalePlayerAtRG2022(CocoGauff)) ::: If Coco Gauff is ranked highly or lost to Rafael Nadal, then Coco Gauff is not a male player at RG 2022.
